definition: Outpatient services are clinical services where people come to seek assessment or diagnosis, such as autism diagnostic evaluations. In this context, they are the setting in which everyday diagnostic work is carried out.

reasons: The packet does not define what “outpatient services” are in general (e.g., that they are clinical services where people come to seek assessment/diagnosis); it only references “autism outpatient services.”
The definition’s examples and scope (“such as autism diagnostic evaluations” and “everyday diagnostic work”) are not explicitly supported by the packet text provided.

The packet describes a specific context (autism diagnostics and an investigation related to autism outpatient services) rather than supporting a general, field-agnostic definition of “outpatient services.”

The packet only supports outpatient services as a setting for autism diagnostics; it does not support the broader generalization that these are clinical services for assessment or diagnosis in general.
“Everyday diagnostic work is carried out” is not stated in the source and reads as an unsupported extrapolation.
